user.title: New irrigation system
user.description: Give the system a name and choose the weather and outdoor sensors. You will add the zones in the next step.

data_description.weather_entity: Optional: used by the formula, the rain block and the AI analysis. Without it (and without a rain sensor) the rain block stays inactive
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional: otherwise the weather entity temperature is used
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional: otherwise the weather entity humidity is used
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional: your own device that knows whether it is raining (binary sensor on = rain, or a rain rate/amount sensor > 0). When set it decides instead of the weather; if it stops answering the weather is used
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional: wind speed from your own weather station. Without it the weather entity wind is used, if it has one

zone.title: Zone {count}
zone.description: Configure one zone: one valve with its drippers.

data_description.name: e.g. Second floor, Attic, Vegetable garden
data_description.valve: Switch or valve entity that opens the water for this zone
data_description.moisture_sensor: Optional: without it the formula assumes 50%
data_description.flow_rate: Liters per minute delivered by the drippers of this zone
data_description.min_duration: The calculated time never goes below this
data_description.max_duration: The calculated time never goes above this
data_description.coefficient: 1 = formula as is; 1.2 = 20% more water; 0.8 = 20% less
data_description.soil_volume: Liters of substrate in this zone (used by the AI analysis)
data_description.exposure: Main orientation of the zone (used by the AI analysis)
data_description.plants: What grows in this zone, in your words: e.g. rosemary and lavender, tomatoes, potted lemon tree. The AI uses it to size the water
data_description.schedule: Every other day counts from the day you choose it. You can change it later from the card
data_description.learning: After each watering the zone checks how far its soil moisture rises and adjusts the next dose by itself. Needs a soil moisture sensor. You can also switch it on and off from the card
data_description.formula: Optional: replaces the system formula for this zone only. Leave empty to use the system formula

schedule.title: Scheduling
schedule.description: When and how to water. You can change everything later from the integration options.

data_description.start_mode: Sunset, sunrise or a fixed time of your choice
data_description.sunset_offset: Only for sunrise and sunset: minutes after the event; negative = before (e.g. -30 = half an hour before sunrise)
data_description.run_mode: In parallel all zones open together; in sequence one after the other (useful with low water pressure)
data_description.safety_minutes: A valve opened by hand closes automatically after these minutes (0 = never)
data_description.close_on_startup: If Home Assistant restarts with a valve open and no cycle running, it closes it
data_description.live_devices: Phones and tablets with the Home Assistant app: during watering they show a Live Activity (iPhone, Dynamic Island) or a Live Update (Android 16+) with each zone and its end time
data_description.live_url: Optional: dashboard opened by tapping the Live Activity, e.g. /lovelace/irrigation
data_description.notify_services: Notify actions for simple messages (start, end, skipped cycles, dry soil, errors), e.g. notify.pushover
data_description.time_format: For the cards and the Live Activity. Automatic = the format of each user's profile (Live Activity: 12 h in the United States, 24 h elsewhere)
data_description.date_format: For the cards. Automatic = the format of each user's profile
data_description.dry_threshold: If a zone's soil moisture stays below this for 5 minutes you get a notification (0 = off)
data_description.rain_forecast_hours: With the rain block on, the cycle is skipped if the hourly forecast shows rain within these hours (0 = only rain falling now). Skipped if the weather service has no hourly forecast
data_description.frost_temperature: Current temperature or the next 3 hours of forecast. Leave empty to turn the check off
data_description.wind_max: Wind from the wind sensor or the weather entity (0 = off). Skipped if no wind data is available
data_description.learn_target: Soil moisture a zone with self-learning should reach after watering

formula.title: Duration formula
formula.description: Write a Jinja template that returns the minutes of watering. Available variables: `moisture` soil moisture % (min 10, 50 if no sensor), `temperature` outdoor °C (20 if missing), `humidity` outdoor %, `weather` weather state (sunny, rainy...), `raining` (true/false, from the rain sensor or the weather), `weather_factor` (sunny 1.1, partlycloudy 0.8, cloudy 0.5, rain 0.2), `coefficient`, `flow_rate` L/min, `soil_volume` L, `exposure` (north, south, east, west), `min_duration`, `max_duration`, `plants` (text). You can also read any entity with `states('sensor.xxx')`. The result is always kept between the zone minimum and maximum.

data_description.formula: The default is the classic formula: change it as you like

formula_preview.title: Formula preview

ai.title: AI analysis
ai.description:
Optional: an AI model can decide whether to water and how many liters each zone needs, using current weather, rain of the last 12 hours and the forecast. You can use an AI Task entity already set up in Home Assistant or your own API key. You can turn the analysis on and off later with the 'AI analysis' switch.

Where to get the API key: [OpenAI]({openai_url}) · [Anthropic Claude]({anthropic_url}) · [Google Gemini]({gemini_url}) · [Ollama]({ollama_url}) (free, local) · [AI Task]({ai_task_url})

ai_details.title: AI service settings
ai_details.description:
🔑 Where to get the API key (or how to set up the service): [{key_label}]({key_url})

A small test request is sent to check the settings before saving.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Created by an AI integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama...) in Home Assistant
data_description.ai_api_key: Stored in the Home Assistant configuration
data_description.ai_model: Model name as the service calls it
data_description.ai_on_error: What to do if the AI does not answer or answers badly. You always get a notification
data_description.ai_instructions: Optional: plants, pots, local climate... e.g. 'tomatoes in 40 L pots, windy terrace'
data_description.ai_prompt: Jinja template with the instructions for the AI. Variables: data_json (all the data), zones, weather_now, rain_last_hours, forecast_next_hours, notes, language. The answer format is always added at the end. Empty it to go back to the default prompt

error.valve_in_use: This valve is already used by another zone.
error.min_greater_than_max: The minimum duration is greater than the maximum.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected ({error}). Check that it was copied whole, that it is still active and that the project can use the chosen model.

options.ai_task: AI Task entity of Home Assistant

options.formula_disable: Water with the formula and turn off the AI analysis

start.name: Start irrigation
start.description: Starts a cycle on all zones.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Same minutes for every zone; empty = formula or manual timer.

force.name: Ignore weather blocks
force.description: Start even if it is raining or rain, frost or strong wind is expected.

stop.name: Stop irrigation
stop.description: Stops the running cycle and closes the valves.

analyze.name: Analyze with AI
analyze.description: Asks the AI whether and how much to water, without watering. Returns the result.

set_schedule.name: Set zone schedule
set_schedule.description: Changes when a zone is watered. Target: the zone's Schedule entity.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: off, alternate (every other day, starting today), days, daily.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays (mon…sun). Alone, they also set the mode to 'Chosen days'; an empty list turns the zone off.

reset_learning.name: Reset self-learning
reset_learning.description: Brings a zone's learned factor back to 1. Target: the zone's Self-learning switch.

entry_not_found.message: Irrigation system not found or not loaded.

schedule_empty.message: Give a mode or the days.
